data.name: Alessio
data.gender_notes: Alessio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Alexios', meaning 'helper' or 'defender'. In Christian tradition, Saint Alessio was a bishop who helped persecuted Christians during the Roman Empire. The name Alessio carries the meaning “Defender, Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alessio usually hope their child will grow to embody defender, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alessio total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אלסיו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלסיו הוא שם שמשמעותו מגן אלוהים משמר ומגן, נגזר מהשם היווני אלכסיוס, שמקורו במילה היוונית אלכסיס שפירושה מגן או הגנה. שם זה משקף את האמונה בהגנה האלוהית ובמשמורת האל.

in_greek.name: Αλέξιος
in_greek.meaning: Αλέξιος ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αλέξιος προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Αλέξιος, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης' ή 'αμυνόμενος από τον Θεό'. Αυτό το όνομα συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'αλέξω', που σημαίνει 'προστατεύω' ή 'αμύνω', και εκφράζει την ιδέα της προστασίας και της ασφάλειας που προσφέρει ο Θεός.

in_latin.name: Alexius
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alexius derivatur a voce Graeca 'alexis', quae 'defensor' vel 'tutela' significat. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen exprimit fidem in protectione divina et tutela Dei, quae creduntur homines fideles defendere et servare.

in_english.name: Alessio
in_english.long_meaning: Alessio is of Greek origin, derived from Alexios (Αλέξιος), meaning 'defender of God' or 'divine protector'. It stems from the Greek word 'alexis', which means 'to defend' or 'to protect'. This name reflects a strong spiritual significance, symbolizing the protection and defense offered by God. Historically, Alessio has been used in various Christian cultures, embodying the virtues of faith, protection, and divine guidance.
